blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Эта река разливается ___ (каждый год, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **каждый → каждый** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ый → -ый.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: Tom has been sneezing all week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я — declines like DLI's тётя: A. тётю. Ending -я → -ю.  **весь → всю** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новая: A. новую. Ending -вся → -ю (the stem changes: вс-).  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Да я у них похудел в ___ (одни сутки, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). Plural-only, inanimate; nominative plural сутки; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **один → одни** (acc. pl., agreeing with сутки). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новые: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -одни → - (the stem changes: одни-).  Declension: sg. — · — · — · — · — · —; pl. сутки · суток · суткам · сутки · сутками · сутках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.
